items.title: The new AI trade: Visa, Shopify, and more
items.summary: Host Kenny Polcari, Robinhood CIO Stephanie Guild, and Payne Capital Management President Ryan Payne discuss why they believe the AI trade is still alive, and how investors can reduce spending risk by looking beyond hyperscalers and semiconductors.

items.title: Vertiv stock sinks on earnings miss: A look at key AI infrastructure players
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings (VRT) stock sinks on Wednesday after missing its second quarter earnings estimates despite its increase to full-year guidance. Vertiv is a major player in AI data center infrastructure. Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian and Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to weigh in on the outlook for the rest of the major companies participating in the AI infrastructure buildout.

items.title: Stocks to Watch Recap: Ford, Caterpillar, Teva, Starbucks
items.summary: ↗️ Ford Motor (F): Despite posting a drop in second-quarter revenue, the automaker boosted its full-year earnings outlook. Shares closed up a little over 2%. ↘️ Caterpillar (CAT): The construction-equipment maker’s shares dropped around 7% amid concerns about data centers and a downgrade from analysts at Baird.

items.title: Caterpillar invests in the future of manufacturing talent in Illinois
items.summary: Caterpillar announced that it intends to invest up to $10 million in its Illinois operations to build the state's future workforce.

items.title: Stock Market Today, July 29: Stocks Slide on Hawkish Fed and Increased Middle East Tensions
items.summary: On July 29, 2026, a hawkish shift from three Federal Reserve officials rattled investors who were already bracing for geopolitical risks.

items.title: Caterpillar Stock Downgraded as AI-Driven Rally Faces a Big Threat
items.summary: Baird analyst Mig Dobre bumped the shares to Hold from Buy. His price target dropped by $300, to $900 each.

items.title: Dow Drops 1,153 Points as Oil Pops on Fed Day: Stock Market Today
items.summary: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reassured markets about a resilient economy, but geopolitical uncertainty remains the major factor for most interested parties right now.

items.title: Caterpillar Stock Drops 6.2% as Baird Cuts AI Outlook
items.summary: Baird reduced its price target by $300 as data-center restrictions created new risks for Caterpillar's power-equipment growth.
